Map units of measure between the CRM and your Books item units. Unmapped units block a push at the line level, not the whole order.
Decide whether missing contacts and items may be created automatically. Most shops turn contact creation on and item creation off, so the item master stays curated by accounts.
Run the pre-flight check. It creates a draft sales order for one item, reads it back, and voids it.
Post one real accepted quote and confirm the totals in Zoho Books match the quote to the cent before enabling the connector for the team.
limitations: Zoho Books API rate limits apply per organisation and are shared with every other app you have connected. A shop running several Zoho apps against one organisation can hit the ceiling and see syncs deferred to the next cycle.
We post one sales order per accepted quote. We cannot merge several quotes into a single consolidated order, and we cannot split one quote across multiple orders.
Quote attachments, drawings and terms text do not transfer. Only the fields listed above move.
Recurring invoices, retainer invoices, purchase orders, bills, expenses and inventory adjustments are out of scope and will stay that way.

Multi-currency works, but we post at the exchange rate held in Zoho Books at the moment of posting. If Books has a stale rate, the posted order carries the stale rate and we will not correct it afterwards.
If a Zoho Books admin deletes a synced sales order, we do not resurrect it. The CRM record shows Unlinked and someone has to decide what should happen next.

troubleshooting.error: Connection drops after 90 days with an invalid_grant error
troubleshooting.cause: The OAuth refresh token was revoked, usually because the authorising user's Zoho password changed or their account was deactivated.
troubleshooting.fix: Reconnect from Settings, Integrations, Zoho Books using an account that is not going to be deactivated. Authorise with a shared admin identity rather than an individual estimator's login.

troubleshooting.error: Post fails with Custom field limit reached
troubleshooting.cause: The Books organisation already uses its full allowance of custom fields on the sales order module.
troubleshooting.fix: Delete an unused custom field in Zoho Books, then click Repair setup in the connector. The connector will not silently drop the quote ID field, because without it nothing is traceable.

troubleshooting.error: Tax total in Books is off by a few cents against the quote
troubleshooting.cause: Zoho Books rounds tax at the line level while the quote rounded at the document level, or a discount was entered as a percentage on one side and an amount on the other.
troubleshooting.fix: Set Rounding to Line level in the connector settings to match Books, then re-post. Do not adjust the quote to make the numbers agree.

troubleshooting.error: Duplicate contacts created for the same customer
troubleshooting.cause: The customer had no GSTIN and their email domain differed from the one on the existing Books contact.
troubleshooting.fix: Merge the contacts in Zoho Books, then open the CRM customer and use Link existing contact to bind to the surviving record.

troubleshooting.error: Sync shows Deferred for several cycles
troubleshooting.cause: The organisation's API rate limit was consumed by another connected application.
troubleshooting.fix: Check the API usage page in Zoho. If another app is the cause, stagger its schedule. Our queue is preserved and drains automatically once headroom returns.

faqs.q: Do I need Zoho CRM as well?
faqs.a: No. This connector talks to Zoho Books only. KanchanFlow is the CRM; adding Zoho CRM alongside it would give you two systems arguing about who owns the customer record.

faqs.q: Which tiers include Zoho Books?
faqs.a: Starter includes one accounting connector of your choice. Professional and Enterprise include all three of Tally, Zoho Books and QuickBooks. An extra connector on Starter is $15 per month.

faqs.q: Can I post as an invoice instead of a sales order?
faqs.a: Yes, it is a workspace-level setting. We default to sales order because posting straight to an invoice recognises revenue on quote acceptance, which most accountants do not want.

faqs.q: What happens to a quote revision after it has posted?
faqs.a: Nothing automatic. Once a quote has posted, a new revision does not rewrite the Books document. You either amend in Books or void and re-post, and the connector records which you did.

faqs.q: Does it work with the US edition of Zoho Books?
faqs.a: Yes. Sales orders, invoices, contacts, items and payments all sync. The GST, HSN and place-of-supply fields simply do not exist there, and the connector hides them.

faqs.q: How fast does payment status appear in the CRM?
faqs.a: Within one fifteen-minute cycle in normal conditions. You can also press Sync now on the order record if someone is on the phone waiting for an answer.

items.tiers: All tiers — Starter selects one accounting connector; Professional and Enterprise include all three

items.name: QuickBooks Online & Enterprise
items.tagline: Post accepted quotes to QuickBooks as estimates, sales orders or invoices, and bring A/R ageing back to the estimator's screen.
items.metaDescription: Two-way QuickBooks Online and Enterprise sync for manufacturers: customers, quotes, invoices and sales tax. What syncs, what does not, and how to set it up.
items.answer: KanchanFlow, the RFQ-to-Order CRM, posts an accepted quote into QuickBooks Online or QuickBooks Desktop Enterprise as an estimate, sales order or invoice, with customer, item, class and sales-tax fields mapped. A/R ageing returns to the customer record, so an estimator sees a 90-day balance before quoting the next job.
intro: For most USA job shops QuickBooks is the system the accountant will not give up, and there is no reason they should. The problem is that quoting in QuickBooks is miserable: no revision history, no cost buildup, no way to hold six variants of the same part. So shops quote in a spreadsheet and re-key the winner.

This connector lets the two systems each do what they are good at. KanchanFlow holds the RFQ, the four-column cost buildup and every revision. When the customer accepts, the finished numbers land in QuickBooks in whichever document type your bookkeeper actually works from, and the A/R position comes back so sales is not the last to know a customer stopped paying.

syncTo.detail: Selectable per workspace. QuickBooks Online supports Estimate and Invoice; Sales Order exists only in Desktop Enterprise and the connector hides it when you are on Online.
Matched on the QuickBooks customer ID we stored on first link, then on exact display name. Ship-to plants can post as sub-customers so a multi-plant account rolls up correctly in QuickBooks reports.
Quote lines post as Non-inventory or Service items by default, keyed on part number. Inventory items are matched but never created, because creating one wrong affects your inventory valuation.
Territory maps to Class and the producing plant maps to Location, if class and location tracking are switched on in QuickBooks.

The customer's tax code and the automated sales tax setting in QuickBooks Online decide the tax. We pass the taxable flag and the ship-to address and let QuickBooks compute the rate, rather than computing it ourselves.
The quote number and revision go into the document number field where your numbering scheme allows it, and always into the customer memo.

syncFrom.detail: Pending, accepted, closed, paid or voided, refreshed each cycle onto the order timeline.
Payments applied to a synced invoice, including deposits taken against an estimate, appear on the customer 360.
Current, 1-30, 31-60, 61-90 and 90+ balances per customer, shown as a band on new quotes for that account.
Credit memos applied to a synced invoice, so sales does not chase a balance that has been credited.
Net 30, Net 45 and similar terms are read back and shown on the quote header so estimators quote against the terms accounting actually granted.

items.cadence: Every 15 minutes for QuickBooks Online; every 30 minutes for Desktop Enterprise via the Web Connector, or on demand

screenshots.caption: The Intuit OAuth consent screen showing the company file being authorised and the scopes requested.
screenshots.note: Capture the genuine Intuit screen. Date stamp required; company name may be blurred.

screenshots.caption: A KanchanFlow accepted quote with the QuickBooks panel showing the matched customer, the document type selector, and the resolved sales-tax treatment.
screenshots.note: Capture against a customer with automated sales tax enabled. Date stamp required.

screenshots.caption: The QuickBooks A/R ageing badges as they render on the KanchanFlow customer 360, with a genuine 61-90 day balance.
screenshots.note: Do not stage a zero-balance account for this shot. Date stamp required; recapture each quarter.

setup: Decide first whether you are connecting QuickBooks Online or QuickBooks Desktop Enterprise. The two use completely different plumbing and the setup diverges from step three.
In KanchanFlow open Settings, Integrations, QuickBooks and choose your edition.
For QuickBooks Online, click Connect to QuickBooks and sign in with an Intuit account that has Company Administrator rights on the company file you want to bind.
For Desktop Enterprise, download the KanchanFlow QuickBooks Web Connector package, then in QuickBooks go to File, App Management, Update Web Services and add the supplied .qwc file.

In Desktop Enterprise, set the Web Connector to Auto-Run at 30-minute intervals and allow access even when QuickBooks is not running. Without that second setting the sync stops every time someone closes QuickBooks.
Choose the document type an accepted quote should create: Estimate, Sales Order in Desktop, or Invoice.
Confirm the item type used for newly posted lines. Non-inventory Part is the default. Ask your bookkeeper before changing it, because item type drives which account the revenue posts to.
Map income accounts. Every posted line must resolve to an income account; the connector will not guess and will hold the push if a mapping is missing.
Turn on Class and Location mapping only if you already use class tracking. Half-populated classes make QuickBooks reports worse, not better.
Confirm sales tax handling. On QuickBooks Online we recommend leaving automated sales tax in control and passing only the taxable flag.
Run the pre-flight check, which posts a one-line document, reads it back and voids it.
Post one real accepted quote and have your bookkeeper open it in QuickBooks and confirm the account coding before you enable the connector for everyone.
limitations: QuickBooks Desktop Enterprise syncs through the Web Connector, which means the sync is only as reliable as the Windows machine it runs on. Thirty minutes is the realistic floor, and a machine that sleeps stops the sync entirely.
We never create Inventory items and we never adjust quantity on hand. If your quote line is an inventory part that does not exist in QuickBooks, the push holds and asks a human to create it.

QuickBooks Online enforces a limit on how many custom fields a document can carry, and older company files may already be at it. Where we cannot write the quote number to a custom field, it goes to the memo instead.
Progress invoicing, job costing detail, time tracking, purchase orders, bills and payroll are all out of scope.
Multi-currency posts at the QuickBooks rate on the day, and we do not revalue afterwards.

There is no field-level conflict resolution. If a bookkeeper edits a synced document in QuickBooks and an estimator revises the quote in KanchanFlow, we do not merge the two. The CRM record is flagged Diverged and someone must choose.

troubleshooting.error: Post fails with An income account is required for this item
troubleshooting.cause: A quote line resolved to an item with no income account mapping, commonly a newly added service line.
troubleshooting.fix: Open the connector's account mapping table, assign an income account for that item type, and re-push. The queued document is not lost.

troubleshooting.error: Web Connector reports QuickBooks is not running or company file is not open
troubleshooting.cause: Desktop Enterprise was closed and the company file was not configured for background access.
troubleshooting.fix: In QuickBooks, open Edit, Preferences, Integrated Applications, select KanchanFlow and tick Allow this application to log in automatically. Restart the Web Connector.

troubleshooting.error: Sales tax on the posted invoice differs from the quote
troubleshooting.cause: The quote computed tax from a stored rate while QuickBooks Online recalculated using automated sales tax and the ship-to address.
troubleshooting.fix: Treat QuickBooks as authoritative for tax and switch the connector to Pass taxable flag only. Then correct the quote template so estimators are not quoting a rate the invoice will not match.

troubleshooting.error: Customer matched to the wrong QuickBooks record
troubleshooting.cause: Two customers share a display name, or a name was matched before the QuickBooks customer ID was stored.
troubleshooting.fix: Open the CRM customer, click Unlink, then Link existing and pick the correct QuickBooks customer by ID. The link is stored by ID from then on and will not re-match by name.

troubleshooting.error: Connection needs re-authorising roughly every 100 days
troubleshooting.cause: Intuit refresh tokens expire, and the expiry clock resets only when the token is used.
troubleshooting.fix: Reconnect when prompted. A workspace that has been idle for months will always need this, so reconnect before a busy quoting week rather than during one.

faqs.q: Which tiers include QuickBooks?
faqs.a: Starter includes one accounting connector of your choice. Professional and Enterprise include all three of Tally, Zoho Books and QuickBooks. Adding a second connector on Starter costs $15 per month.

faqs.q: Does it work with QuickBooks Desktop Pro or Premier?
faqs.a: We test and support Enterprise. Pro and Premier expose the same Web Connector interface and generally work, but we do not run the quarterly regression against them, so we will not claim support we have not tested.

faqs.q: Will it overwrite anything my bookkeeper has edited?
faqs.a: No. Once a document has posted we do not update it. If the quote changes afterwards, the record is flagged Diverged in the CRM and a person decides what to do.

faqs.q: Can it post to a specific QuickBooks numbering series?
faqs.a: It can write to the document number field where your preferences allow custom numbering. If QuickBooks controls numbering, the quote number goes to the memo instead and the link is maintained by ID.

faqs.q: Does A/R ageing update in real time?
faqs.a: It updates each sync cycle: fifteen minutes on Online, thirty on Desktop. The badge on the customer record carries the time of the last successful read so nobody trusts a stale number.

faqs.q: What data leaves QuickBooks?
faqs.a: Only the fields in the two tables on this page. We do not read your chart of accounts beyond the income accounts you map, and we never read payroll, banking or bill data.

items.tiers: All tiers — Starter selects one accounting connector; Professional and Enterprise include all three

items.name: MyOB
items.tagline: Post accepted quotes to MyOB Business or AccountRight as sales orders with GST handled the Australian way, and read payment status back.
items.metaDescription: MyOB integration for manufacturing CRM: post accepted quotes as MyOB sales orders with Australian GST tax codes and payment write-back. Setup and limits.
items.answer: KanchanFlow, the RFQ-to-Order CRM, connects to MyOB Business and AccountRight Live through MyOB's own API so an accepted quote becomes a sales order with Australian GST tax codes and ABN-matched contacts. It is the connector that opens the Wave 2 Australian market, and it sits outside the three-connector count in our pricing table.
intro: MyOB is here because Australian job shops asked for it and because the Wave 2 Australian market depends on it. It behaves much like the Zoho Books connector: cloud API, OAuth, no bridge software, and a deliberately narrow scope that leaves the ledger to the accountant.

The differences are Australian. Tax codes are GST, FRE, EXP and N-T rather than a rate you type. Contacts are matched on ABN. Terms are expressed in MyOB's own balance-due-days convention. The connector handles all four so an estimator in Melbourne is not translating an American accounting model in their head.

syncTo.detail: The accepted quote posts as a Sale of type Order, leaving the conversion to an Invoice with your bookkeeper. The KanchanFlow quote number goes in the Customer PO field.
Matched on ABN first, then on the stored MyOB contact UID. New cards carry the trading name, ABN, billing address and the buyer as the contact person.
Each quote line posts with item number, description, quantity, unit price and the resolved tax code. GST is applied for domestic sales and EXP for exports, rather than a hard-coded ten per cent.
Where you use MyOB jobs, the CRM order number maps to the MyOB job so cost and revenue land against the same job in AccountRight reporting.
The quote owner maps to an employee card, and the customer's payment terms map to MyOB's balance-due-days model.

syncFrom.detail: We report when an order has been converted to an invoice, and carry the invoice number back onto the CRM order record.
Payments recorded against the converted invoice show on the customer 360 payment strip.
Read per customer card and shown as a warning band on new quotes for that account.
If accounts changes the credit terms on the MyOB card, the CRM picks up the new terms on the next cycle rather than continuing to quote the old ones.

items.cadence: Every 15 minutes for MyOB Business; every 30 minutes for AccountRight Live company files, or on demand

screenshots.caption: The MyOB OAuth consent screen with the company file selector, showing which file is being bound.
screenshots.note: Capture the genuine MyOB consent flow. Date stamp required; business name may be blurred.

screenshots.caption: A KanchanFlow accepted quote with the MyOB panel showing the ABN it matched on and the resolved GST tax code per line.
screenshots.note: Capture with at least one EXP-coded export line present so the tax logic is visible. Date stamp required.

screenshots.caption: The resulting Sale — Order inside MyOB with the quote number in the Customer PO field.
screenshots.note: Capture in AccountRight. Date stamp required; recapture each quarterly re-test.

setup: Confirm which MyOB product you run. MyOB Business connects over the cloud API directly; AccountRight must be an AccountRight Live file, not a purely local one.
In KanchanFlow, open Settings, Integrations, MyOB and click Connect.
Sign in with a my.MyOB account that has access to the company file, and complete MyOB's two-factor prompt.
Enter the company file credentials if your file has a user ID and password set. MyOB requires these separately from the my.MyOB login and the connector cannot proceed without them.
Select the company file to bind. One KanchanFlow workspace binds to one company file.
Map tax codes. Confirm which code is your standard GST code, which is your export code, and which applies to freight lines.
Map income accounts for each item type you quote, including freight and tooling if you charge them as separate lines.
Decide whether missing customer cards may be created. Most Australian shops turn this on because ABN matching is reliable enough to avoid duplicates.
Turn on job mapping only if you already use MyOB jobs. Partially populated jobs make AccountRight job reporting less useful, not more.
Run the pre-flight check, which writes a one-line order, reads it back and deletes it.
Post one real accepted quote and have your bookkeeper confirm the tax codes and account coding before enabling it for the team.
limitations: AccountRight Live only. A classic AccountRight file kept solely on a local drive has no API surface and cannot be connected at all.

MyOB is not one of the three accounting connectors counted in our pricing table. It is included on Professional and Enterprise; on Starter it needs the extra accounting connector add-on at $15 per month.
MyOB's API applies per-file throttling that we do not control. Large first-time contact syncs can take several cycles to complete and there is no way to speed that up.
We do not write purchase orders, bills, payroll, inventory adjustments or bank transactions, and will not.
Item creation is off by default and we recommend leaving it off, because MyOB item numbers are short and collisions with your existing numbering are easy to create and painful to unwind.

This is our least-exercised accounting connector. It passes the same quarterly regression as the others, but it has the smallest number of shops running it in production, so an unusual company-file configuration is more likely to surface a bug here first.

troubleshooting.error: Connect fails with Company file credentials required
troubleshooting.cause: The AccountRight file has a user ID and password set at the file level, which is separate from the my.MyOB sign-in.
troubleshooting.fix: Enter the file-level user ID and password in the connector setup. If nobody remembers them, an AccountRight administrator can reset them from within the file.

troubleshooting.error: Post rejected: Tax code is not valid for this account
troubleshooting.cause: The income account mapped for that line is restricted to a different tax code in MyOB's account setup.
troubleshooting.fix: Either change the account mapping in the connector or relax the tax code restriction on the MyOB account. Do not change the tax code on the quote to force it through.

troubleshooting.error: Duplicate customer cards appear
troubleshooting.cause: The customer had no ABN in KanchanFlow, so we fell back to name matching and MyOB's name differed by punctuation.
troubleshooting.fix: Merge the cards in MyOB, then Link existing contact from the CRM customer record. Add the ABN so future matching uses it.

troubleshooting.error: Sync shows Throttled for several cycles
troubleshooting.cause: MyOB is rate-limiting the company file, usually during a large initial contact import.
troubleshooting.fix: Wait. The queue drains automatically. If it persists past a day, reduce the contact sync scope to active customers only in connector settings.

troubleshooting.error: Order posts but the job number is blank
troubleshooting.cause: Job mapping is enabled but the referenced MyOB job does not exist or is marked inactive.
troubleshooting.fix: Create or reactivate the job in MyOB, then use Repost on the CRM order. We do not create jobs automatically because job codes are usually governed by a scheme we cannot infer.

faqs.q: Why is MyOB here when the site is USA-first?
faqs.a: Because Australia is the Wave 2 market and a real number of USA manufacturers have an Australian subsidiary or distributor running MyOB. It ships now so those shops are not blocked later.

faqs.q: Which tiers include MyOB?
faqs.a: Professional and Enterprise include it. On Starter it needs the $15 per month extra accounting connector add-on, because Starter's included connector is one of Tally, Zoho Books or QuickBooks.

faqs.q: Does it handle Australian GST correctly?
faqs.a: It resolves the MyOB tax code per line rather than applying a fixed percentage, so GST, FRE, EXP and N-T all behave as MyOB expects. Your bookkeeper should still check the first real order.

faqs.q: Can I run MyOB alongside QuickBooks for a US parent?
faqs.a: Yes on Professional and Enterprise, one connector per workspace binding. Many groups run one workspace per legal entity for exactly this reason.

faqs.q: Does it work with MyOB Essentials?
faqs.a: MyOB Essentials files migrated to MyOB Business connect normally. Files still on the retired Essentials platform do not, and MyOB is retiring that platform anyway.

faqs.q: What happens if the company file is being upgraded?
faqs.a: MyOB locks the file during an upgrade and our writes fail cleanly. The queue holds and drains once the upgrade finishes; nothing is lost and nothing posts twice.

items.tiers: Professional and Enterprise — on Starter, via the $15/month extra accounting connector add-on

items.name: ClearTax GSP (e-Invoice IRN)
items.tagline: Register an invoice with the government e-invoice portal through ClearTax and get the IRN, signed QR and acknowledgement on the order.
items.metaDescription: ClearTax e-invoice IRN integration: generate IRN and signed QR codes for India invoices from your manufacturing CRM, with error codes explained.
items.answer: KanchanFlow, the RFQ-to-Order CRM, uses ClearTax as its GST Suvidha Provider to register invoices with the government e-invoice portal and return the IRN, the signed QR code and the acknowledgement number onto the order record. The feature is included on every tier, because a legal filing requirement is not something we will gate behind a plan.
intro: India's e-invoicing mandate means an invoice above the turnover threshold is not legally valid until the Invoice Registration Portal has issued an IRN for it. That is a filing step, not a sales step, but it lands on whoever raised the invoice, and in a small shop that is often the same person who quoted the job.

This connector puts the step where the invoice already is. When an order is invoiced, KanchanFlow builds the IRN payload from the fields the quote already carries, sends it through ClearTax as GSP, and writes the IRN, acknowledgement number, acknowledgement date and signed QR back onto the record so the printed invoice carries the QR the portal issued.
items.frame: This connector is for USA manufacturers with India operations, India-based contract customers, or manufacturers exporting to India. If your India entity raises GST invoices above the e-invoicing threshold, this is a compliance requirement, not an optional convenience.

syncTo.detail: Seller GSTIN, buyer GSTIN, document type, document number and date, and every line with HSN, quantity, unit, rate, taxable value and tax split, assembled to the current e-invoice schema.
Where an e-way bill is needed, distance, transporter ID and vehicle number are submitted alongside so Part A can be generated with the IRN in one call.
Shipping bill number, port code, country code and the with-payment or without-payment-of-tax flag are submitted for export invoices, including LUT-backed zero-rated supplies.
A cancellation with its reason code can be submitted within the 24-hour portal window directly from the order record.
Notes raised against a registered invoice are submitted with the original IRN referenced, so the portal links them to the right document.

syncFrom.detail: The 64-character hash returned by the portal, stored on the order and printed on the invoice.
The base64 signed QR returned by the IRP, rendered onto the invoice PDF at the size the mandate requires.
The Ack No and Ack Date, which are what an officer asks for in an assessment.
Where an e-way bill was generated in the same call, its number and validity date come back onto the shipment record.
The raw IRP error code and message, shown verbatim rather than translated, because the code is what a chartered accountant will ask you to read out.

items.cadence: On demand at invoice registration; status polling every 15 minutes until the portal responds

screenshots.caption: The order record's compliance panel before registration, showing the pre-flight validation of GSTIN, HSN and place of supply with any blocking field highlighted.
screenshots.note: Capture a record that genuinely fails one validation so the reader sees what a block looks like. Date stamp required.

screenshots.caption: The same panel after successful registration, showing IRN, Ack No, Ack Date and the rendered signed QR code.
screenshots.note: Capture from a sandbox IRP so no live IRN is published. Date stamp required and the sandbox banner must remain visible.

screenshots.caption: The invoice PDF with the signed QR code placed at mandate size, alongside the IRN in the document header.
screenshots.note: Capture the generated PDF, not a design mockup. Date stamp required; recapture each quarterly re-test.

setup: Confirm your India entity is actually within the e-invoicing mandate for the current financial year. If you are below the threshold, do not enable this connector.
Obtain a ClearTax GSP account for your GSTIN. KanchanFlow does not resell ClearTax; you hold the commercial relationship with them.
In the ClearTax dashboard, create API credentials and note the client ID, client secret and the GSTIN they are scoped to.
On the government e-invoice portal, create an API user for your GSTIN and select ClearTax as the GSP. This is a separate step from the ClearTax account and is the one most shops miss.
In KanchanFlow, open Settings, Integrations, ClearTax and enter the client ID, client secret, portal API username and password.
Select Sandbox first. The connector defaults to sandbox and will not let you switch to production until a sandbox registration has succeeded.
Map your document types. Regular invoices, credit notes, debit notes and export invoices each carry a different document type code and must be confirmed.
Configure the invoice template to place the signed QR code and IRN. The PDF template will not render either until you do this.
Run a sandbox registration on a real invoice's data. Read the returned IRN and QR to confirm the payload is what you expect.
Have your chartered accountant review the sandbox payload before you switch to production. This is a legal filing; a second pair of eyes is cheap.
Switch to production, register one live invoice, and verify it on the e-invoice portal's own search page.
Enable the 24-hour cancellation control for the users who should have it, and nobody else.
limitations: The portal allows cancellation of an IRN within 24 hours only. After that window the only remedy is a credit note, and no integration can change that.

The IRP is a government service with its own maintenance windows and occasional multi-hour outages. When it is down, nothing we do makes an invoice register, and we will show you the portal's own error rather than pretending to retry forever.
We register invoices. We do not file GSTR-1, GSTR-3B or any return, and we do not reconcile GSTR-2B. That remains your accountant's work in Tally, Zoho Books or ClearTax's own filing product.
ClearTax is the only GSP we support. If your entity is contracted to a different GSP, this connector is not usable and we have no workaround to offer.

Schema changes are mandated by the government with short notice. When the schema version changes we ship an update, but there can be a gap of a few days between the mandate date and our release, during which registrations using new fields will fail.

The e-way bill call is best-effort. Where distance validation or vehicle number format fails at the portal, the IRN still generates but the e-way bill does not, and you will have to complete it on the portal manually.

troubleshooting.error: Error 2150: Duplicate IRN
troubleshooting.cause: The same document number and financial year was already registered, usually because a first attempt succeeded but the response was lost.
troubleshooting.fix: Use Fetch IRN by document number in the compliance panel. If the portal returns an existing IRN, we attach it to the order rather than re-registering.

troubleshooting.error: Error 2172: Invalid HSN code
troubleshooting.cause: A line carries an HSN that is not in the portal's master, or is too short for the turnover band that applies to your entity.
troubleshooting.fix: Correct the HSN on the item master, not on the single quote line, then re-run registration. Six or eight digits are required depending on turnover.

troubleshooting.error: Error 2176: Recipient GSTIN is inactive or cancelled
troubleshooting.cause: Your customer's GSTIN has been suspended or cancelled since you took the order.
troubleshooting.fix: Validate the GSTIN with the Karza connector, contact the customer, and do not register the invoice against a cancelled GSTIN. This is a commercial problem before it is a technical one.

troubleshooting.error: Error 2189: Invalid place of supply for the tax type charged
troubleshooting.cause: The invoice charges CGST and SGST while the place of supply is a different state, or the reverse.
troubleshooting.fix: Fix the ship-to state on the order, regenerate the invoice, and register again. Do not edit the tax lines directly to force the payload through validation.

troubleshooting.error: Authentication failed at the GSP with no further detail
troubleshooting.cause: The portal API user password was changed or expired, or the API user was never linked to ClearTax as GSP.
troubleshooting.fix: Reset the API user password on the e-invoice portal, confirm ClearTax is selected as the GSP for that GSTIN, and re-enter the credentials in the connector.

faqs.q: Is e-invoicing gated by tier?
faqs.a: No. GST, GSTIN validation, HSN handling, e-invoice IRN and the 43B(h) tracker are on every tier including Starter. Charging more for a legal filing requirement would be indefensible.

faqs.q: Do I need a ClearTax subscription of my own?
faqs.a: Yes. ClearTax is the GSP and you hold that account and its costs directly. We integrate with it; we do not resell it.

faqs.q: Can I cancel an IRN from inside the CRM?
faqs.a: Within the government's 24-hour window, yes, with a reason code, and only for users you have given that permission. After 24 hours the portal itself refuses, and the correct route is a credit note.

faqs.q: What happens if the government portal is down when I invoice?
faqs.a: The invoice stays in Pending registration and we keep polling. You will see the portal's own status message. We will not mark an invoice registered that has not been.

faqs.q: Does this replace my GST return filing?
faqs.a: No. This registers invoices and nothing more. Returns are filed from your accounting system or ClearTax's filing product by whoever does that work today.

faqs.q: Does it work for export invoices?
faqs.a: Yes, including shipping bill number, port code and both with-payment and without-payment-of-tax LUT cases. Export is the reason most USA manufacturers end up needing this connector at all.

items.tiers: All tiers — India GST, IRN and 43B(h) features are never gated by plan

items.name: Karza (KYC + GSTIN validation)
items.tagline: Validate a customer's GSTIN, PAN and corporate identity against the source registries before you quote, not after they default.
items.metaDescription: Karza GSTIN validation integration: verify GSTIN, PAN, CIN and bank details at customer onboarding, with GST filing status and MSME classification.
items.answer: KanchanFlow, the RFQ-to-Order CRM, uses Karza to validate a customer's GSTIN, PAN, CIN and bank account against the source registries at the moment of onboarding. It also returns GST filing regularity and MSME classification, which is what makes the Section 43B(h) payment tracker usable rather than guesswork.
intro: A wrong GSTIN is not a data-quality irritation. It fails e-invoice registration, it books tax to the wrong state, and it can leave you unable to claim input credit on a job you have already shipped. Most shops discover the problem at invoicing, which is the worst possible moment.

This connector moves the check to onboarding. Type a GSTIN into a new customer record and we call Karza, return the registered legal name, trade name, principal place of business, registration date and current status, and refuse to save a cancelled GSTIN silently. The same call tells us whether the counterparty is a registered micro or small enterprise, which drives the 43B(h) payment clock.
items.frame: This connector is for USA manufacturers with India operations, India-based contract customers, or manufacturers exporting to India. If none of your counterparties hold an Indian GSTIN, you do not need it.

syncTo.detail: The GSTIN typed on a customer or plant record is submitted for verification the moment the field loses focus, before the record can be saved as active.
PAN is verified against the income tax registry for name match, which is what catches a customer who has given you a group entity's PAN by mistake.
Company identification numbers are submitted to return directors, incorporation date and company status, used on Enterprise workspaces for counterparty due diligence.
Account number and IFSC are submitted for a name-match verification before a customer refund or a dealer payout is set up.
The full active customer list is resubmitted quarterly so a GSTIN that was cancelled after onboarding is caught before the next invoice.

syncFrom.field: Legal name, trade name and status
syncFrom.detail: The registered legal name, trade name and whether the GSTIN is Active, Suspended or Cancelled, written to the customer record and shown as a badge.

syncFrom.field: Principal place of business and state code
syncFrom.detail: The registered address and state code, which we use to drive the place-of-supply tax logic rather than relying on typed addresses.
Which of the last several GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B periods were filed, surfaced as a simple regular or irregular filer signal on the credit panel.
Whether the counterparty is registered as a micro, small or medium enterprise, which sets the Section 43B(h) payment window on any payable to them.

syncFrom.field: Registration date and constitution of business
syncFrom.detail: Used on the customer 360 header so a salesperson can see they are dealing with a six-month-old proprietorship rather than a thirty-year-old private limited company.

items.cadence: Real time on entry; full re-validation of active customers every 90 days

screenshots.caption: The new-customer form mid-validation, showing a GSTIN typed in and the Karza response populating legal name, trade name and principal place of business.
screenshots.note: Capture live with a genuine public-sector GSTIN so no private customer data is shown. Date stamp required.

screenshots.caption: A customer record showing a Cancelled GSTIN warning banner with the cancellation date and the blocked action.
screenshots.note: Capture from a sandbox with a deliberately cancelled test GSTIN. Date stamp required.

screenshots.caption: The 43B(h) exposure panel showing counterparties classified as micro or small via Udyam data, with days remaining on each payment clock.
screenshots.note: Capture with real day counts, not zeros. Date stamp required; recapture each quarterly re-test.

setup: Obtain a Karza account and API credentials for your India entity. As with ClearTax, you hold this relationship directly and we do not resell it.
In the Karza dashboard, enable the specific products you intend to use: GSTIN verification, PAN verification, and optionally CIN lookup and bank penny-drop.
Note your Karza API key and the environment base URL. Sandbox and production keys are different and are not interchangeable.
In KanchanFlow, open Settings, Integrations, Karza and paste the key. Start in sandbox.
Choose which checks run automatically on customer creation. GSTIN is on by default; PAN, CIN and bank verification are off because each one costs a call.
Set the enforcement level. Warn shows a banner and allows the save; Block prevents activating a customer with a cancelled or invalid GSTIN. Most shops start on Warn and move to Block after a month.
Turn on MSME classification capture if you have India payables, because this is what feeds the Section 43B(h) tracker.
Set the quarterly re-validation window to run outside business hours. It consumes one call per active customer.
Run a sandbox validation on five real customer GSTINs and compare the returned legal names against your own records. Expect to find at least one mismatch.
Switch to production and re-run the same five to confirm the production key is live.
Brief your sales team on what a Suspended badge means before they see one on a live account, so the first conversation with the customer is an informed one.
limitations: Karza is a paid per-call service that you buy directly. High-volume validation costs money, and our quarterly re-validation of every active customer is the single largest consumer of calls. You can narrow its scope, but you cannot make it free.
GST filing regularity data lags the portal by a variable period, typically a few days. It is a credit signal, not a real-time statement of a counterparty's compliance.

Udyam MSME classification is only returned where the counterparty has actually registered on the Udyam portal. An unregistered micro enterprise is invisible to this check, so the 43B(h) tracker cannot be complete on its own.
Bank penny-drop performs a name match, which returns a similarity result rather than a yes or no. A near-match still needs a human decision and we will not decide it for you.
We validate. We do not remediate. If a GSTIN is cancelled, the connector tells you and stops; renegotiating with that customer is not something software does.
No Karza call is made for non-Indian counterparties, so a USA-only workspace gets no value from this connector at all and should leave it switched off.

troubleshooting.error: Validation returns Invalid GSTIN format before any call is made
troubleshooting.cause: The GSTIN failed our local checksum validation, so we did not spend a paid API call on it.
troubleshooting.fix: Check the entry for the common transpositions between the letter O and the digit zero, and between the letter I and the digit one, in positions three to seven.

troubleshooting.error: Karza returns Source unavailable
troubleshooting.cause: The upstream GST registry is down or throttling. Karza passes this through rather than caching a stale answer.
troubleshooting.fix: The record saves as Validation pending and we retry automatically on a backoff. Do not force-approve the customer to clear the badge.

troubleshooting.error: Legal name from Karza does not match the customer name in the CRM
troubleshooting.cause: You are dealing with a trade name or a divisional name rather than the registered legal entity.
troubleshooting.fix: Keep the trade name as the display name and store the registered legal name in the legal name field. Invoices and e-invoice payloads must use the legal name.

troubleshooting.error: Quarterly re-validation consumed far more calls than expected
troubleshooting.cause: The batch ran against all customers including inactive and archived ones.
troubleshooting.fix: Set the re-validation scope to customers with activity in the last twelve months in connector settings, then check the call estimate the connector shows before the next run.

troubleshooting.error: MSME classification is blank for a supplier you know is small
troubleshooting.cause: The counterparty has not registered on the Udyam portal, so there is no record to return.
troubleshooting.fix: Record the classification manually on the counterparty record with a note of the evidence you hold. The 43B(h) tracker will use the manual value and mark it as self-declared.

faqs.q: Is GSTIN validation gated by tier?
faqs.a: No. GSTIN validation, GST, IRN and the 43B(h) tracker are available on every tier including Starter. What varies by tier is the advanced 43B(h) exposure calculator, which is an Enterprise capability.

faqs.q: Do I pay Karza or you?
faqs.a: You pay Karza directly for API calls. We charge nothing for the connector. This keeps the cost visible instead of buried in a seat price.

faqs.q: Can I stop it validating on every save?
faqs.a: Yes. You can restrict automatic validation to customer creation only, and run everything else manually from the record. That is the cheapest configuration.

faqs.q: What does the Suspended badge actually mean?
faqs.a: It means the GST registry currently shows that GSTIN as suspended. It usually precedes cancellation and it is a strong signal to check with the customer before you extend more credit.

faqs.q: Does it store personal data?
faqs.a: It stores the business registry fields listed in the sync tables against the customer record. Director names from a CIN lookup are stored only on Enterprise workspaces where that check is switched on.

faqs.q: Do I need this if I only sell within the USA?
faqs.a: No. Leave it off. It has no function outside India-registered counterparties and we would rather tell you that than sell you a switch you will never use.

items.tiers: All tiers — India GST and compliance features are never gated by plan

items.name: Aadhaar eSign
items.tagline: Get a legally valid electronic signature on a quote acceptance or supply agreement in minutes, using India's OTP-based eSign service.
items.metaDescription: Aadhaar eSign integration for manufacturing CRM: OTP-based legally valid signature on quote acceptances and supply agreements, with a full audit trail.
items.answer: KanchanFlow, the RFQ-to-Order CRM, connects to a licensed eSign Service Provider so a buyer can sign a quote acceptance or supply agreement with an Aadhaar OTP and a legally valid digital signature is embedded in the PDF. The signature receipt and full audit trail attach to the quote revision that was signed, not to a loose file.
intro: Chasing a signed acceptance is the slowest part of winning a job. A quote is agreed on a call, and then a scanned page with a rubber stamp arrives four days later, sometimes against a revision that is no longer current. Half the disputes we hear about start with somebody signing the wrong revision.

Aadhaar eSign fixes both halves. The buyer receives the exact quote revision as a PDF, authenticates with an OTP against their Aadhaar number, and the signature is embedded in the document by a licensed ESP. The signed PDF, the ESP receipt, the timestamp and the IP address bind to that revision permanently.
items.frame: This connector is for USA manufacturers with India operations, India-based contract customers, or manufacturers exporting to India. Only signatories with an Aadhaar number and a mobile number registered against it can use it, so it complements rather than replaces your normal signature process.

syncTo.detail: We send the SHA-256 hash of the exact quote revision PDF to the ESP. The document itself does not leave your workspace during the signing ceremony.
Name and mobile number of the named buyer on the quote, used to address the OTP challenge. We never transmit or store the Aadhaar number itself.
The page, x and y coordinates and the box size where the signature block is to be embedded, taken from the document template.
Quote acceptance, supply agreement, NDA or amendment, which drives both the retention policy and which template is used.
The reminder cadence for an unsigned request, sent by email and, where enabled, by WhatsApp through the WABA connector.

syncFrom.detail: The returned PDF carries the embedded digital signature and is stored against the quote revision as an immutable attachment.
The provider's own receipt, including certificate serial and the signing timestamp, stored alongside the document.
Timestamp, IP address, device user agent and OTP verification result for each attempt, successful or not.
Sent, viewed, OTP requested, signed, declined or expired, each written to the quote timeline as it happens.

items.cadence: Real time via webhook during the signing ceremony; status reconciliation every 15 minutes

screenshots.caption: The Send for eSign dialog on a quote, showing the exact revision number being sent and the named signatory with their mobile number partially masked.
screenshots.note: Capture from a live workspace with the mobile number masked in the UI itself, not blurred afterwards. Date stamp required.

screenshots.caption: The ESP's own OTP consent screen as the signer sees it on a phone, showing the document hash and the consent text.
screenshots.note: Capture the genuine provider screen on a real handset in sandbox mode. Date stamp required.

screenshots.caption: The completed quote timeline showing sent, viewed, signed events with timestamps, and the signed PDF attached to Rev 2.
screenshots.note: Capture a genuinely multi-revision quote so the revision binding is visible. Date stamp required; recapture each quarter.

setup: Confirm your signing use case is one eSign supports. Aadhaar eSign is valid for commercial contracts and acceptances; it is not valid for documents excluded under the first schedule of the IT Act, such as certain negotiable instruments and powers of attorney.
Contract with a licensed eSign Service Provider. KanchanFlow supports ESPs that expose the standard eSign 2.1 API; your provider must confirm they do.
Obtain your ASP credentials and the signing certificate from the provider, plus their sandbox endpoint.
In KanchanFlow, open Settings, Integrations, Aadhaar eSign, enter the credentials and upload the provider certificate.
Set the callback URL shown in the connector inside your ESP dashboard so signature completion webhooks reach your workspace.
Configure the signature block position on each document template you intend to have signed. A signature that lands over a price table is a support ticket waiting to happen.
Set the document expiry window. Seven days is the default; anything past thirty invites signing against a stale revision.
Decide which roles can send a document for signature. This is a legal act and should not be available to every user by default.
Enable WhatsApp reminders only if the WABA connector is configured and the signatory has opted in, otherwise reminders go by email alone.
Run a sandbox ceremony end to end with a colleague, including a deliberate OTP failure, so you have seen what a decline looks like.
Switch to production and sign one real low-value acceptance before using it on a contract that matters.
limitations: The signatory must hold an Aadhaar number with a currently registered mobile number. Anyone outside India, or without that mobile linkage, cannot use this method at all, which rules out most USA-based buyers.
OTP delivery depends on the UIDAI service and Indian mobile networks. Neither we nor the ESP can guarantee delivery time, and during outages there is no fallback except waiting.
Signatures bind to a specific quote revision. If the quote is revised after sending, the outstanding request is voided rather than transferred, which is deliberate and cannot be turned off.
We do not offer a document-signing workflow with multiple sequential signatories, counter-signature routing or in-person witness capture. One document, one signatory, one ceremony.

Aadhaar eSign is not accepted for every document class under Indian law, and it carries no validity outside India. Cross-border contracts usually need a different instrument, and we will tell you so rather than let you assume otherwise.

Certificates issued through this route are short-validity signing certificates. The signature remains verifiable, but the certificate is not reusable for other systems the way an organisational DSC token is.

troubleshooting.error: Signer reports no OTP received
troubleshooting.cause: The mobile number on the quote is not the number registered against that Aadhaar, or UIDAI's OTP service is congested.
troubleshooting.fix: Confirm the registered mobile with the signer directly, correct it on the quote, and resend. Do not send to a colleague's phone; the number must be the signer's own registered number.

troubleshooting.error: Signature request shows Voided after a revision
troubleshooting.cause: The quote was revised while a signature request was outstanding, so we voided the request rather than let a signature bind to superseded numbers.
troubleshooting.fix: Send a fresh request against the new revision. Tell the signer why, because they may have the old PDF open.

troubleshooting.error: Webhook never arrives and status stays at OTP requested
troubleshooting.cause: The callback URL in the ESP dashboard is wrong, or an outbound firewall is blocking the provider.
troubleshooting.fix: Re-copy the callback URL from the connector page. Our 15-minute reconciliation poll will eventually correct the status, but webhooks should be fixed rather than relied on failing.

troubleshooting.error: Signed PDF fails signature validation in a third-party reader
troubleshooting.cause: The verifying application does not trust the Indian CCA root chain by default.
troubleshooting.fix: Install the CCA India root certificates in the reader's trust store. The signature is valid; the reader simply does not know the issuer.

troubleshooting.error: Provider returns Consent text mismatch
troubleshooting.cause: The consent wording configured in the connector differs from the wording registered with the ESP.
troubleshooting.fix: Copy the exact consent text from your ESP contract into the connector. This text is legally prescribed and cannot be reworded for tone.

faqs.q: Is an Aadhaar eSign legally valid?
faqs.a: Yes, under the Information Technology Act it carries the status of a valid electronic signature for most commercial documents, with specific exclusions. Your legal counsel should confirm it fits your document class before you rely on it.

faqs.q: Do you store Aadhaar numbers?
faqs.a: No. The Aadhaar number is entered by the signer on the ESP's own screen. We handle the document hash, the signatory name and the mobile number, and nothing else.

faqs.q: Can a USA-based customer sign this way?
faqs.a: No. Aadhaar eSign requires an Aadhaar number with a registered Indian mobile. For USA buyers, use your existing signature process; this connector complements it rather than replacing it.

faqs.q: Which tiers include it?
faqs.a: All tiers. Like the rest of the India regulatory set, it is not gated by plan.

faqs.q: What happens if the customer signs the wrong revision?
faqs.a: They cannot. A request binds to one revision, and revising the quote voids any outstanding request. That constraint exists precisely because signing a stale revision is the most expensive mistake in this workflow.

faqs.q: Can two people sign the same document?
faqs.a: Not today. Multi-signatory routing is not something we ship, and we would rather say so than describe a workaround that leaves you with an unclear audit trail.

items.tiers: All tiers — India regulatory and signature features are never gated by plan

items.name: Razorpay & RazorpayX
items.tagline: Attach a payment link to a quote, take an advance before the job is scheduled, and see the settlement land on the order record.
items.metaDescription: Razorpay integration for manufacturing CRM: payment links on quotes, advance and milestone collection, UPI and NEFT reconciliation, RazorpayX dealer payouts.
items.answer: KanchanFlow, the RFQ-to-Order CRM, generates Razorpay payment links against a quote or milestone so a buyer can pay an advance by UPI, card or netbanking, and the paid amount reconciles automatically onto the order. RazorpayX adds outbound dealer payouts for shops that pay commission on channel-sourced orders.
intro: The advance is the moment a quote becomes a job. Until the money moves, a shop is holding capacity for someone who has not committed. Most shops handle this with a bank detail block at the bottom of the quote PDF and a phone call three days later asking whether the transfer went out.

With this connector the payment link is part of the quote itself. The buyer taps it, pays by UPI or card, and the order record shows Advance received with the payment ID against it before anyone has picked up the phone. Milestone and balance payments work the same way, and RazorpayX handles the money going the other direction to dealers.
items.frame: This connector is for USA manufacturers with India operations, India-based contract customers, or manufacturers exporting to India. Razorpay settles to an Indian bank account, so a USA-only shop should use the Stripe connector instead.

syncTo.detail: Created against a quote, an order milestone or a proforma, carrying amount, currency, description, the CRM reference and an expiry date. The link is embedded in the quote PDF and can be sent by email or WhatsApp.
Name, email and mobile so Razorpay can send its own reminders and so the payment is attributable to a person, not just an amount.
Where you allow it, the link accepts a partial amount with a defined minimum, which is how advance-then-balance terms are enforced without creating two links.
Dealer commission payouts are submitted with beneficiary account, IFSC, amount, purpose and the CRM payout reference, on approval by whoever holds the payout role.
Quote number, order number, territory and dealer code are written into Razorpay notes so finance can reconcile in the Razorpay dashboard without opening the CRM.

syncFrom.detail: Payment ID, method, amount and timestamp arrive by webhook within seconds of capture and post to the order timeline.
The settlement ID and bank UTR once Razorpay settles to your account, which is the reference your accountant will match against the bank statement.
Full and partial refunds against a synced payment, with reason, so a salesperson is not chasing money that has been returned.
Failure reason codes and any dispute raised, surfaced on the order rather than left in the payment gateway dashboard.
For RazorpayX, whether a dealer payout is queued, processing, processed or reversed, with the reversal reason where relevant.

items.cadence: Real time by webhook for payments and payouts; a 15-minute reconciliation sweep catches anything a webhook missed

screenshots.caption: A quote with the payment panel open, showing an advance percentage, the generated link, its expiry, and the buttons to send it by email or WhatsApp.
screenshots.note: Capture from a live workspace in test mode. Date stamp required; the link itself must be a test-mode link.

screenshots.caption: The order timeline after capture, showing payment ID, method, amount and the settlement UTR once settled.
screenshots.note: Capture a genuine test payment that has reached settlement, not a captured-only event. Date stamp required.

screenshots.caption: The RazorpayX payout approval screen showing a dealer commission payout awaiting approval, with beneficiary details masked.
screenshots.note: Masking must be in the product, not applied in post-processing. Date stamp required; recapture each quarter.

setup: Confirm your Razorpay account is activated with a settlement bank account and KYC complete. A test-mode-only account can be connected but cannot take real money.
In the Razorpay dashboard, create API keys under Settings, API Keys. Copy the key ID and secret; the secret is shown once.
In KanchanFlow, open Settings, Integrations, Razorpay and enter the key ID and secret. Start in test mode.

Copy the webhook URL shown in the connector and add it in Razorpay under Settings, Webhooks, subscribing to payment captured, payment failed, refund processed, settlement processed and, if using RazorpayX, payout events.
Set the webhook secret in both places. A webhook without a verified signature is refused by the connector rather than trusted.
Configure the default advance percentage and whether partial payments are allowed. Thirty to fifty per cent advance is what most job shops set.
Set the payment link expiry. Seven days is the default and keeps stale links from being paid against superseded quotes.
Place the payment block on your quote PDF template. Without this, links can still be sent but will not appear on the printed quote.
If you want dealer payouts, enable RazorpayX separately, fund the account, and assign the payout approval role to a named finance user.
Run a test payment of one rupee end to end and confirm the order timeline updates without anyone touching it.
Switch to live keys, re-add the live webhook, and take one real advance before rolling it out to the sales team.
limitations: Razorpay settles to Indian bank accounts and is regulated as an Indian payment aggregator. A shop with only a USA bank account cannot use it; use Stripe instead.

International card acceptance on Razorpay requires separate approval from them and is not enabled by default, so an overseas buyer may find the link declines even though it works for domestic customers.
Settlement timing is Razorpay's, typically T+2 or T+3 depending on your account. We report the settlement, we do not accelerate it.
We do not perform three-way reconciliation between the payment, the accounting invoice and the bank statement. We show the UTR; matching it in Tally or Zoho Books remains an accounting task.
Payment links are per quote or per milestone. There is no customer-level statement link that lets a buyer pay several open invoices in one transaction.
RazorpayX payouts are irreversible once processed. Our approval step is the only control, and if the wrong beneficiary is approved neither we nor Razorpay can pull the money back.

troubleshooting.error: Payment succeeded but the order still shows unpaid
troubleshooting.cause: The webhook did not reach us, usually because the webhook secret differs between Razorpay and the connector.
troubleshooting.fix: Re-enter the same secret in both places. The 15-minute reconciliation sweep will pick up the payment in the meantime, so no money is lost, only visibility.

troubleshooting.error: Webhook signature verification failed in the connector log
troubleshooting.cause: The webhook was configured on the live keys while the connector is still in test mode, or the reverse.
troubleshooting.fix: Match the mode. Test and live webhooks are separate objects in Razorpay and each has its own secret.

troubleshooting.error: Link expired before the customer paid
troubleshooting.cause: Expiry is set shorter than your customer's approval cycle, common when a buyer needs internal sign-off.
troubleshooting.fix: Regenerate the link from the quote, which creates a fresh link against the current revision. Consider a fourteen-day expiry for accounts with slow internal approvals.

troubleshooting.error: Partial payment received when full payment was expected
troubleshooting.cause: Partial payments are enabled on the link and the buyer chose to pay less than the full amount.
troubleshooting.fix: The order shows the balance outstanding and a second link can be issued for it. If you never want this, disable partial payments at the connector level.

troubleshooting.error: RazorpayX payout reversed with beneficiary account invalid
troubleshooting.cause: The dealer's IFSC or account number is wrong, or the account is dormant.
troubleshooting.fix: Correct the dealer's bank details on the dealer record, verify them with a penny-drop through the Karza connector, and re-issue the payout.

faqs.q: Can I take an advance before scheduling production?
faqs.a: That is the main reason this connector exists. Set an advance percentage on the quote and the order stays in Awaiting advance until the payment webhook lands.

faqs.q: Which tiers include Razorpay?
faqs.a: All tiers. The advance-collection workflow is part of quote-to-order and is not a plan gate.

faqs.q: Does the money touch KanchanFlow?
faqs.a: No. Funds move between your customer and your Razorpay account, and settle to your bank. We hold references and statuses, never money.

faqs.q: Can I use Razorpay and Stripe together?
faqs.a: Yes. Shops with both a USA and an India entity commonly run Stripe for USA customers and Razorpay for Indian ones, and the connector chooses based on the currency on the quote.

faqs.q: What happens if a customer pays twice?
faqs.a: Both payments post to the order and the record shows an overpayment. We do not auto-refund. A person decides whether to refund or hold it against the balance.

faqs.q: Are dealer payouts available on every tier?
faqs.a: RazorpayX payouts sit alongside the dealer portal and hierarchy, which are Professional and Enterprise capabilities. Inbound payment links work on all tiers.

items.tiers: All tiers for inbound payment links; RazorpayX dealer payouts on Professional and Enterprise

items.name: Stripe
items.tagline: Send a hosted payment link with a quote, take a deposit by card or ACH, and reconcile the payout back onto the order.
items.metaDescription: Stripe integration for manufacturing CRM: hosted payment links on quotes, card and ACH deposits, milestone billing and payout reconciliation.
items.answer: KanchanFlow, the RFQ-to-Order CRM, creates Stripe payment links against a quote or a production milestone so a buyer can pay a deposit by card or ACH debit. Captures, refunds, disputes and payouts return by webhook, so the estimator sees the deposit land without asking accounting whether the money arrived.
intro: A USA job shop that takes a fifty per cent deposit on tooling has a cash-flow reason to make paying easy. Most of the friction is procedural: a PDF with wire instructions, a purchasing department that needs a W-9, and a week of nobody being sure whether the money is coming.

This connector puts a hosted Stripe link on the quote and reports back the moment it is paid. ACH debit is supported for the buyers who will not put a machine order on a card, and the payout reference comes through so the deposit can be matched in QuickBooks against the actual bank deposit rather than guessed at.

syncTo.detail: Created against a quote or milestone with amount, currency, description, the CRM reference and an expiry. Hosted by Stripe so no card data ever reaches our systems or yours.
Created or matched on email, carrying company name, billing address and the CRM customer ID in metadata, so Stripe's dashboard shows who paid without a lookup.
Quote number, revision, order number and territory are written to payment intent metadata, which is what makes reconciliation in the Stripe dashboard possible.
Card, ACH debit and, where you enable it, Link. ACH is the one that matters for deposits above a few thousand dollars.
Full or partial refunds initiated from the order record, with reason, and only by users holding the refund permission.

syncFrom.detail: Requires payment, processing, succeeded or canceled, on the order timeline in near real time.
The charge ID, the Stripe fee and the net amount, so the order shows what you actually received rather than what was quoted.
The Stripe payout ID and expected arrival date, which is the link between a charge and a line on your bank statement.
Dispute reason, evidence deadline and outcome, surfaced on the order because a chargeback on a shipped job is a commercial emergency.
ACH debits can fail days after they appear to succeed. Failure codes come back onto the order so nobody treats a reversed payment as received.

items.cadence: Real time by webhook; a 15-minute reconciliation sweep backfills any missed event

screenshots.caption: A quote with the deposit panel open, showing the deposit percentage, the generated Stripe link, the enabled payment methods and the expiry.
screenshots.note: Capture in Stripe test mode from a live workspace. Date stamp required.

screenshots.caption: The Stripe hosted checkout page as a buyer sees it, with the ACH debit option visible alongside card.
screenshots.note: Capture the genuine hosted page in test mode. Date stamp required; do not mock this screen.

screenshots.caption: The order timeline showing charge amount, Stripe fee, net received and the payout ID with expected arrival date.
screenshots.note: Capture a test charge that has an associated payout so the reconciliation chain is visible end to end. Date stamp required.

setup: Confirm your Stripe account is activated for live payments with a bank account attached and business verification complete.
Decide whether you need ACH debit. If you do, enable it in the Stripe dashboard under Payment methods before connecting, because it needs Stripe's approval on some accounts.
In KanchanFlow, open Settings, Integrations, Stripe and click Connect. We use Stripe Connect OAuth, so you authorise on Stripe's own screen rather than pasting a secret key.
Confirm the account being connected is the correct one if you hold several Stripe accounts. The account name is shown on the consent screen; read it.
Copy the webhook endpoint from the connector into Stripe under Developers, Webhooks, subscribing to payment_intent, charge, refund, payout and dispute events.
Set the deposit percentage default. Fifty per cent on tooling and thirty on repeat production is a common starting point, and it can be overridden per quote.
Set the link expiry. Fourteen days suits USA purchasing cycles better than seven, because a PO often has to pass through a controller.
Place the payment block on the quote PDF template so the link prints on the document the buyer forwards internally.
Assign the refund permission deliberately. By default no role holds it, and that is correct.
Run a test payment in test mode, then a one dollar live charge, and confirm both appear on the order timeline with the fee and net amounts.
Refund the live one dollar charge from the order record to confirm the refund path works before you need it under pressure.
limitations: ACH debit settles slowly and can fail up to several business days after it appears to have succeeded. Do not release a shipment on an ACH payment that has not settled, and the order badge will tell you which state it is in.
Stripe fees are deducted before payout, so the net you receive is less than the deposit you quoted. We report the fee, we do not add it to the buyer's total for you.
We do not support Stripe Billing subscriptions, invoicing through Stripe Invoices, or Stripe Tax. Deposits and one-off milestone payments only.
Disputes must be defended in the Stripe dashboard. We surface the deadline and the reason code but we cannot upload evidence on your behalf.
One Stripe account per workspace. A group with several legal entities and separate Stripe accounts needs a workspace per entity.
Payment links do not carry sales tax logic. The amount on the link is the amount on the quote; if tax handling is wrong on the quote, it is wrong on the link.

troubleshooting.error: Payment succeeded in Stripe but the order shows nothing
troubleshooting.cause: The webhook endpoint is missing an event type, most often payment_intent.succeeded, or the endpoint was added to the wrong Stripe mode.
troubleshooting.fix: Check the endpoint's subscribed events and mode in the Stripe dashboard. The reconciliation sweep will catch it within fifteen minutes regardless.

troubleshooting.error: ACH payment marked Reversed several days after it succeeded
troubleshooting.cause: The buyer's bank returned the debit, commonly for insufficient funds or a closed account.
troubleshooting.fix: The order reverts to unpaid with the return code shown. Contact the buyer before shipping. This is a property of ACH, not a bug in the connector.

troubleshooting.error: Connect flow authorises the wrong Stripe account
troubleshooting.cause: The user was signed into a different Stripe account in the same browser.
troubleshooting.fix: Disconnect in the connector, sign out of Stripe, and reconnect while signed in to the intended account. Verify the account name on the consent screen.

troubleshooting.error: Refund fails with Charge has already been refunded
troubleshooting.cause: Someone refunded in the Stripe dashboard and then again from the CRM.
troubleshooting.fix: Refresh the order; the reconciliation sweep imports dashboard-issued refunds. Agree with your team which system issues refunds and stick to it.

troubleshooting.error: Buyer reports the link is expired
troubleshooting.cause: The link passed its expiry while sitting in a purchasing inbox.
troubleshooting.fix: Regenerate from the quote, which issues a fresh link bound to the current revision. If this happens often, lengthen the default expiry rather than reissuing manually each time.

faqs.q: Does card data ever touch your servers?
faqs.a: No. Payment pages are hosted by Stripe. We hold payment intent IDs, statuses and amounts. We never see a card number and we are not in your PCI scope for this flow.

faqs.q: Which tiers include Stripe?
faqs.a: All tiers. Taking a deposit is part of quote-to-order, not a premium feature.

faqs.q: Can I bill milestones rather than one deposit?
faqs.a: Yes. Each production milestone on an order can carry its own link and amount, and the order shows the running total collected against the contract value.

faqs.q: Do you handle sales tax on the payment?
faqs.a: No. The link charges the quote amount. Sales tax belongs on the quote and, for USA shops, is usually computed by QuickBooks at invoicing. We do not use Stripe Tax.

faqs.q: What about international customers?
faqs.a: Stripe accepts most international cards on a USA account, subject to Stripe's own rules. For customers who will pay only into an Indian account, use the Razorpay connector instead.

faqs.q: Can I refund from the CRM?
faqs.a: Yes, if your role has the refund permission, which no role holds by default. Every refund is written to the order timeline with the user who issued it.

items.tiers: All tiers

items.name: WhatsApp Business API (WABA)
items.tagline: Send quotes, follow-ups and production updates on WhatsApp from the CRM, with every thread attached to the RFQ it belongs to.
items.metaDescription: WhatsApp Business API for manufacturing CRM: send quotes and follow-ups, thread replies onto the RFQ, manage templates, and see per-message billing.
items.primaryKeyword: whatsapp business api for manufacturing crm
items.answer: KanchanFlow, the RFQ-to-Order CRM, connects to the official WhatsApp Business API so quotes, follow-ups and production updates send from a verified business number and every reply threads onto the RFQ it belongs to. Message billing is Meta cost plus a published markup of twenty, fifteen or ten per cent by tier.
intro: In a lot of shops the real quote conversation happens on WhatsApp, on a salesperson's personal phone, and it leaves with them when they do. Nobody else can see what was promised, and the follow-up that would have won the job never happens because the person who owned the thread is on site.

Moving that conversation onto the official Business API changes who owns it. Messages send from a verified business number, threads attach to the RFQ or quote rather than to a person, and the Quote Follow-Up agent can draft the two-day and seven-day nudges. The number belongs to the company, so a salesperson leaving does not take the history with them.

syncTo.detail: Approved templates for quote sent, quote follow-up, order confirmed, production milestone and dispatch, each with the quote number, part description and amount injected as variables.
The quote PDF or drawing sent as a document message, capped by Meta at 100 MB and by us at 25 MB so the buyer's phone can actually open it.
Free-form replies inside the 24-hour customer service window, sent by a salesperson from the CRM thread rather than from a personal handset.
The Razorpay or Stripe payment link for an advance, sent as a template with the amount and expiry so the buyer can pay from the thread.
Where consent was captured, when, and through which channel, written against the contact because Meta requires you to be able to show it.

syncFrom.detail: Every reply, including images of a part or a hand-marked drawing, threaded onto the RFQ, quote or order it references.
Sent, delivered, read or failed per message, so a salesperson can tell the difference between an ignored quote and an undelivered one.
Meta's own quality rating per template, surfaced in settings, because a template dropping to low quality precedes it being paused.
Meta's conversation category and charge for each 24-hour window, which is what the billing on this page is calculated from.
A customer replying STOP is recorded and further template sends to that number are blocked automatically.

items.cadence: Real time by webhook in both directions; billing reconciliation with Meta once daily

screenshots.caption: The RFQ record with the WhatsApp thread panel open, showing an outbound quote template, the buyer's reply, and a photo of a part they sent back.
screenshots.note: Capture from a live workspace with the customer's number masked in the product. Date stamp required.

screenshots.caption: The template manager showing approved templates with their Meta category, language, quality rating and last-used date.
screenshots.note: Capture the genuine template list including at least one template in a non-approved state. Date stamp required.

screenshots.caption: The WhatsApp usage panel showing messages included this month, messages sent, Meta cost, the applied markup and the running overage total.
screenshots.note: Capture with real non-zero usage. Date stamp required; recapture each quarterly re-test.

setup: Decide which phone number will be your WhatsApp Business number. It must not be in use on the consumer WhatsApp app or the WhatsApp Business app, and moving a number off those apps deletes its chat history.
Create or identify your Meta Business Manager account and complete business verification. This is the slowest step and can take several days.
In KanchanFlow, open Settings, Integrations, WhatsApp and start Embedded Signup, which walks you through Meta's own flow without leaving the CRM.
Create the WhatsApp Business Account and register your number, completing the SMS or voice verification Meta sends.
Set your display name. Meta reviews it, and a name that does not match your registered business will be rejected.
Submit your message templates for approval. Start with quote sent, quote follow-up and order confirmed; approval usually takes minutes but can take a day.
Map each template to the CRM event that triggers it, and set the variable bindings to real fields rather than static text.
Configure the Quote Follow-Up agent cadence if you want automated nudges. Two days and seven days after send is the default and it consumes AI credits per draft.
Record how you capture opt-in. Meta requires it, and the connector will not send a template to a contact with no opt-in record unless you override per contact with a reason.
Set your monthly spend alert. The connector warns at eighty per cent of your included message allowance and again at one hundred.
Send a live test to your own number and confirm the thread appears against a test RFQ.
Brief the sales team that WhatsApp threads are now company records that customers can see quoted back to them, because behaviour changes when a message is on the record.
limitations: Meta controls template approval, quality ratings and messaging limits, not us. A template can be paused or a number's daily limit reduced by Meta with no notice and no appeal we can make on your behalf.

Free-form replies are only possible inside the 24-hour window that opens when a customer messages you. Outside it, only an approved template can be sent, and template categories are priced differently by Meta.
One number per WhatsApp Business Account binding per workspace by default. Starter includes one number and can add two; Professional includes three and can add seven; Enterprise is unlimited.
Migrating an existing number from the consumer WhatsApp app permanently deletes that number's chat history. There is no export and no way back.
Meta's per-conversation pricing changes periodically and varies by country and category. Your bill moves when Meta's rate card moves, and we pass that through rather than absorbing it.
We do not support WhatsApp payments, catalogues, or the shopping cart features, and we have no plan to.

troubleshooting.error: Template send fails with Template not approved
